entries.description: every dictionary entry (headword) on the pages, in reading order across the three columns of each page. one object per headword.

headword.description: the bold headword exactly as printed, including any feminine-form suffix printed after a comma

grammaticalCategory.description: ONLY the part-of-speech marker printed after the headword (the standard Spanish grammatical abbreviations for gender/number/verb class, optionally combined, e.g. a gender marker plus a plural or a second gender). Do NOT include subject-domain or usage-register abbreviations - those begin the definition instead. null if no part-of-speech marker is printed.

definition.description: the definition text as printed, excluding the quoted usage examples. If a subject-domain or usage-register abbreviation is printed after the part-of-speech marker, it starts the definition, transcribed exactly as printed.

exampleQuote.description: the FIRST quoted usage example for this entry, verbatim including the guillemets, or null if the entry has none

exampleSource.description: the attribution/citation printed after the first example, transcribed INCLUDING its enclosing parentheses. null if the example has no attribution.
